data.description: A giant dragonfly is adept at swooping in to attack prey with a powerful bite and then, just as quickly, swooping back up out of reach.  As a result, a giant dragonfly gains Flyby Attack as a bonus feat.  In addition, if a giant dragonfly charges while flying, it receives a +4 bonus on CMB checks made to grapple foes.
data.name: Darting Charge
